Patentability analyser

Describe the invention. Elements are rows, prior-art references are columns; hover a filled cell to read the matching sentence. Bright green cells are gaps — nothing in the prior art covers them. An examiner judges each round; a rejected invention is revised and re-analysed up to three times. Each element gets its own searcher agent, and the examiner runs its own follow-up searches — both are logged below as they work.
